The standout is the Word Insights panel: every word gets a Scrabble score, rare letters (J, Q, X, Z) are flagged, common prefixes and suffixes are detected, and words are grouped by pattern, so you can spot the high-value plays easily instead of scanning a wall of text. A separate Letter Analysis panel breaks down input: vowel/consonant balance, letter frequency, repeated letters, and your most valuable tile.

records.name: Korvyth Bot
records.tagline: Automate your crypto grid trading--your funds, ourstrategy.
records.description: Korvyth Bot — Otomatik grid trading platformu. Şeffaf, güvenli, 7/24 çalışan kripto bot. korvythbot.com Korvyth Bot --- Automate grid trading platform. 7/24 working bot.

records.name: NilaMind
records.tagline: A private, fully on-device mental health companion
records.description: NilaMind is an Android app built around Nila — someone to talk to by voice or text for everyday emotional support. The AI model, crisis-safety checks, voice transcription, and all your data stay on your phone. No account, no backend, no analytics by default. Now with research-backed protocols (Relapse Prevention, Mindfulness, Behavioral Experiments), a redesigned private diary, and clinician PDF export — everything still runs fully on-device, nothing leaves your phone.

records.name: Splition
records.tagline: Split Expenses Not Friendships
records.description: Splition is a sleek, modern web app designed to split expenses with roommates, friends, or couples—without the chaos of group chats. Currently in beta, it offers a clean, ad-free ledger to track who owes what in real time. 4 Split Ways: Equal, Custom, Percentage, or Shares (perfect for couples). Localized: Supports currencies like Naira (₦) and USD. No payment processing: Just pure, honest tracking. Free for up to 3 groups/20 monthly expensesPremium is $4.99/mo.

records.name: ThinkMaps
records.tagline: Build your perfect, ready-to-create, profitable app idea.
records.description: ThinkMaps helps you find an idea worth building, not just build one. Pick a niche, make real decisions on a visual canvas, and watch a personalized idea take shape from your own choices. Then AI competitor research, a strength score, personas, a launch checklist, and landing page copy harden it into something real. Free to start. No idea required.

records.name: NGXSMK UI Kit
records.tagline: Signals-native Angular UI Kit with 200+ components
records.description: NGXSMK UI Kit is an open source Angular component library built for modern applications. It includes 200+ themeable components with support for Angular Signals, standalone components, design tokens, accessibility, light and dark themes, and Angular 17.3+ compatibility. Build dashboards, SaaS apps, admin panels, and enterprise applications faster with a modern developer experience.
